name: cosmos-music-bio-instrument-suite
description: Open-source voice, motion, camera-PPG and CST-inspired adaptive music suite.

scripts.native:android: npm run build && npx cap add android && python scripts/patch-native.py android && npx cap sync android
scripts.native:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios && python scripts/patch-native.py ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
